Question: In the World Bank World Development Indicators table for the indicator 'Rural population (% of total population)', what value is listed for Ethiopia (ETH) in 2023?

A. 76.9413528442383%
B. 78.9262244720308%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Rural population (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.RUR.TOTL.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)

Supplied draft answer: B
